name: Security
checks: Is all untrusted input validated at the boundary, with no SQL, shell, or HTML injection paths introduced?
Are secrets, session tokens, passwords, encryption keys, and private user data excluded from logs, errors, and responses?
Do authentication and authorization checks protect every newly exposed operation and user-owned resource?
Are new dependencies necessary, maintained, and free of known high-severity vulnerabilities?
Do workflow and deployment changes preserve least privilege and avoid exposing write tokens or secrets to pull-request code?
